call_points.text: New core banking system to be launched in Q2/Q3 of FY27 under the Utkarsh 2.0 programme.
JLG disbursements rose 58% QoQ and 2% YoY in Q4FY26; non-JLG rose 41% QoQ and 51% YoY.
Cost of funds fell to 7.9% in Q4FY26 from 8.3% a year earlier; further repricing expected.
Provisioning is not finished: 85% and 70% provisioning buckets partly remain for JLG and MBBL.

guidance.statement: Aiming for loan book growth of 25% to 30% in the coming years
Secured lending to comprise around 55% of the portfolio
Deliver ROE of around 15%, exiting FY28 above 15%
Credit cost around 3% in FY27 and 2-2.5% in FY28
Net NPA to reach below 1% by FY28

operating_notes.text: JLG was ~28% of the gross loan book (~30% including BC JLG) as on March 2026, down from nearly 88% in March 2020.
CGFMU covers ~70% of the microfinance book counting Q4FY26 disbursements, up from ~45% for disbursements till Q3FY26.
PCR was 59.3% overall, 39.0% on the secured book, 65.4% on unsecured and 66.3% for JLG.

timeline.summary: Utkarsh Corelnvest Limited, promoter of Utkarsh Small Finance Bank, confirmed no encumbrance on Bank’s equity shares in FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹836.75 Cr (-4.9% YoY)
Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reported a net loss of ₹188 Cr for Q4FY26 with gross NPAs improving to 7.7%.
Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Limited hosted an earnings conference call on May 11, 2026, at 16:00 IST for Q4 and FY2026 audited financial results, with recording available via the bank’s website.
Utkarsh Small Finance Bank's Q4FY26 call guided FY27 credit cost at ~3%, 25-30% medium-term loan growth and net NPA below 1% by FY28, after a ₹188 Cr quarterly loss on legacy provisioning.
Utkarsh Small Finance Bank said the NCLT order of May 18, 2026 lists its joint amalgamation petition with Utkarsh CoreInvest for hearing on July 23, 2026; a certified copy of the order is awaited.
Utkarsh Corelnvest Limited, promoter of Utkarsh Small Finance Bank, disclosed no encumbrance on Bank’s equity shares in FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Limited will hold an earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 6:15 p.m. IST.
